text: Teaching Objective To cultivate senior applied Stomatology talents with strong hands-on skills, entrepreneurial ability, and strong ability to develop. To cultivate Doctors for diagnosis and treatment of stomatological disease. Graduates acquire following knowledge and ability 1.Basic theoretical knowledge and experimental skills of preclinical medicine and clinical medicine 2.Basic theoretical knowledge and clinical operational skills of various disciplines of Stomatology; 3.Dentistry common disease diagnosis, treatment and initial processing of urgent, difficult, severe symptom; 4.A basic knowledge of dental work and general skills; 5.Mastering medical literature search, the basic method of data survey, with initial capacity of oral medical research.Main coursesBiochemistry, Physiology, Medical Immunology, medical microbiology, Experiment of medical functional science, Pathology, pharmacology, clinical diagnostics, oral anatomical physiology, oral histology and pathology, internal medicine, surgery, Cariology And Endodontics, Periodontics, oral mucosal disease study, oral and maxillofacial surgery, prosthodontics, orthodontics, prevention of oral medicine.Degree AwardedBachelor of Medicine
